title: A Borrowed Sword
era: Spring and Autumn · Duke Ai of Lu

source.book: Records of the Grand Historian, Biographies of the Disciples of Confucius
source.quote: So it was that one journey by Zigong preserved Lu, threw Qi into disorder, broke Wu, strengthened Jin, and made Yue master of the states.

moral: What you cannot move alone, you can move with someone else's strength.
